title: Approve 43 schools extension in Rewa
description: 43 schools under Smart Classroom and PM SHRI in Rewa district require a 45-day extension due to monsoon civil delays. Proposed completion deadline: 30 May 2027.
impact: Avoids contract default and ensures lab commissioning before new academic term.

title: Review performance of Vendor XYZ
description: Vendor XYZ has 19 projects delayed beyond 30 days in Rewa and Jabalpur. Performance notice issued on 28 March. Department review required for penalty imposition or blacklisting.
impact: Sets compliance standard and initiates bank guarantee invocation if unresponsive.

title: Escalate pending inspections in Jabalpur
description: 57 physical verification inspections in Jabalpur are overdue by more than 21 days due to BEO staff shortages. Direct Joint Director to assign alternate field teams.
impact: Unlocks milestone payments and clears school handover certification.

title: Approve payment for 82 completed schools
description: 82 schools across 8 districts have completed 100% physical milestone verification with geo-tagged photographic evidence. Fund release ready in PFMS queue.
impact: Maintains 94% on-time vendor vendor settlement ratio.

title: Release Phase 2 Smart Class funds for Indore
description: Indore district has achieved 91% physical progress on Phase 1 terminals. Release second tranche of ₹4.8 Cr for 45 secondary schools.
impact: Enables timely device delivery before start of monsoon term.

title: Reallocate contractor quota for Chhindwara
description: 24 middle schools in Chhindwara require reallocation from defaulting subcontractor to standby empanelled agency under State Rate Contract.

title: Sanction solar rooftop pilots for 35 PM SHRI schools
description: Pilot proposal for 5kW hybrid rooftop solar installations in 35 PM SHRI exemplar schools with high digital lab load.
impact: Reduces recurring energy bills by 65% and ensures uninterrupted computer lab uptime.
